dataset_name: RelayDesk Hybrid Retrieval Lexical Hard Set
description: Chunk-level gold set for exact technical tokens and operationally adjacent SaaS support procedures.

documents.title: SSO Authentication Failure
documents.content:
# Authentication
## SSO Login Failure
SSO login failure should be checked against the tenant IdP metadata, SAML audience, ACS URL, clock skew, and member mapping. This procedure is different from local password recovery. 适用于 SSO 登录失败。

documents.title: Local Password Login Failure
documents.content:
# Authentication
## Password Login Failure
For a local password login failure, verify the account email, reset channel, lock status, and verification code delivery. Do not change SSO metadata for this case.

documents.title: OAuth Token Refresh Failure
documents.content:
# API Authentication
## OAuth2 Refresh Token
When an oauth2 refresh_token cannot be refreshed, verify client_id, redirect_uri, grant_type, token expiry, and revoked consent. Never disclose client_secret.

documents.title: SDK Initialization Error
documents.content:
# SDK
## Initialization
For E_SDK_INIT_42 or SDK initialization errors, record SDK language and version, runtime version, initialization options, and a redacted stack trace.

documents.title: Webhook 403 Signature Rejection
documents.content:
# Webhook
## HTTP 403
A Webhook returning 403 is commonly rejected after authentication because of signature, timestamp window, callback allowlist, or endpoint policy. Record delivery_id and a redacted signature header.

documents.title: API 500 Server Error
documents.content:
# API
## HTTP 500
An API request returning 500 indicates a server-side processing failure. Record request_id, API path, timestamp, region, response body, and whether the write can be safely retried.

documents.title: Invoice Issuance Failure
documents.content:
# Billing
## Invoice
For an invoice issuance failure, verify invoice title, tax ID, billing entity, billing period, and invoice eligibility. Real issuance requires finance verification. 适用于 invoice 开票失败。

documents.title: Refund Status Verification
documents.content:
# Billing
## Refund Status
A refund status request requires the refund reference, original transaction, approval time, payment channel, and redacted account evidence. The knowledge base cannot confirm a real refund state.

documents.title: Duplicate Charge Investigation
documents.content:
# Billing
## Duplicate Charge
For duplicate charge investigation, compare two transaction IDs, amounts, timestamps, currency, subscription ID, and payment channel before manual finance verification.

documents.title: Workspace Member and Seat Management
documents.content:
# Workspace
## Members and Seats
Workspace member invitations and seat assignments require workspace_id, member email, role, available seat count, and tenant administrator verification.

documents.title: Organization Domain Verification
documents.content:
# Organization
## Domain Verification
Organization domain verification requires DNS ownership proof, organization_id, verified domain, and tenant administrator approval. It is not a Workspace member invitation.

documents.title: Subscription Seat Synchronization
documents.content:
# Subscription
## Successful Payment but Missing Seats
If subscription renewal or seat purchase succeeded but seat count did not increase, record subscription_id, invoice, paid quantity, current seat count, workspace_id, and synchronization time. 适用于订阅扣款成功但席位没有增加。

documents.title: Subscription Payment Failure
documents.content:
# Subscription
## Payment Failed
If subscription payment failed, verify payment method, failure code, billing address, retry state, and whether any charge was actually created. Do not treat this as a seat synchronization issue. 适用于订阅付款失败。
